steps: Complete a free LinkedIn Learning course on Microsoft Office 365 basics to master Outlook, Word, and record-keeping.
Practice calendar management and meeting scheduling by volunteering to organize events for a local education nonprofit.
Enroll in a community college workshop on data entry and documentation to improve efficiency.
Obtain child abuse clearance and attend a basic accounting seminar to prepare for school finance tasks.
Shadow a teaching assistant or science teacher for a day to apply your skills and network in the field.
